text: Five college students spend a weekend at [a cousin's cabin deep in the woods|trigger|travelling somewhere remote], unaware that two engineers in an underground laboratory are steering their every move with drugs and pheromones. In the cellar, Dana reads aloud from the diary of Patience Buckner, a girl [abused by her sadistic family|wrong|cruelty at home], and wakes the Buckners as zombies. As the friends fall one by one, the watchers keep count, because their ritual [requires five deaths in the proper order|wants|the sacrifice demanded] to keep [the Ancient Ones asleep beneath the earth|threat|the devil and dark gods].
